attention_side_channel.epistemic: same canonical per-node E as feature column 1; use unchanged generic sender prior

canonical_row_order: sort by (scenario_id,parent_tick,is_pseudo), clean before pseudo; identical data order and row keys for all methods/seeds
epistemic_side_channel_storage: float64 canonical E supplied identically to both GATs; existing generic compute_epistemic_weights computes Python-float prior then stores float32, while model node features are cast to float32
graph_content_hash: SHA256 of UTF8 sorted compact JSON provenance excluding graph_content_sha256, followed by C-contiguous little-endian float32 node_features bytes, little-endian float64 canonical epistemic side-channel bytes, and C-contiguous uint8 adjacency bytes; shapes/orders fixed here
per_node_target: 1 for every clean/untouched node; 0 only for the single corrupted valid node; provenance only, no auxiliary node loss

inputs: mean of 5 raw GNSS normality scores
population std of those 5 raw scores (ddof=0)
secondary_auxiliary.source: same parent clean GNSS member scores for both members of every pair; no GNSS-only pseudo

target_normal.meaning: constructed normal-vs-controlled-corruption discrimination; neither official anomaly probability nor driving safety

topology.entry_semantics: A[i,j]=1 means sender j communicates to receiver i

unit: one scenario/tick/constructed observation; not a temporal graph
untouched_nodes: copy exact parent compact features AND canonical p/E/A; never zero-fill, re-corrupt, or re-extract clean features
